summary: Structural twin of Matrix3x3VectorMultiply (00435e00): computes the difference vector (a3 - a2), applies the 3x3 matrix stored as 9 doubles (row-major, this+0x0 through this+0x40), and writes the transformed result into a4. Row 0 sums this[0]*dx + this[1]*dy + this[2]*dz, row 1 uses this[3]/this[4]/this[5], row 2 uses this[6]/this[7]/this[8]. Returns the output pointer a4. No branches, globals, or callees; used by suspension/steering/integrator callers (SuspensionSpringDamperForceComputationWithClampi, VehicleMainPhysicsUpdate, VehiclePhysicsVelocityAngularVelocityIntegrator).

operations.description: Set result = a4 (the return value is the output vector pointer).
a4[0] = this[0]*v4 + this[1]*v5 + this[2]*v7 (matrix row 0, offsets +0x0/+0x8/+0x10).
a4[1] = this[3]*v4 + this[4]*v5 + this[5]*v7 (matrix row 1, offsets +0x18/+0x20/+0x28).
a4[2] = this[6]*v4 + this[7]*v5 + this[8]*v7 (matrix row 2, offsets +0x30/+0x38/+0x40).
Return result (the output vector pointer a4).
